items.heading: Radiology Is a Genuinely Strong
items.text: Radiology is a genuinely strong field in India on both of its tracks, not a fading one, but "is radiology good" hides a bigger question most people never ask explicitly: which of two very different careers are you actually asking about?

items.heading: Before Pay, Competitiveness, or AI
items.text: Before pay, competitiveness, or AI risk, there is a structural question almost no "is radiology a good career" article separates clearly enough, and it changes everything else in this decision.

items.heading: A Single "Radiology Salary
items.text: A single "radiology salary in India" number is close to meaningless, because a junior radiologist and a senior radiology technician can earn comparable figures despite completely different training timelines and daily responsibilities.
